content: Documented as intentional non-rotation. close_session advances spiral phase but does NOT rotate session_id — that requires explicit spiral_inherit(). Added this to the tool description and appended a rotation_note to every close_session output reminding callers to call spiral_inherit() to start a genuinely new session. commit 23e10aa.
resolved_from: close_session does not rotate session_id — architectural review needed. close_se
